title: Model-Free Runtime Measurement of Task-Relevant Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.14111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly monitor physical kinematics, environmental states and task completion outcomes. While existing work provides methods to plan information seeking actions and interpret acquired observations, current approaches do not monitor whether the live process of information gathering is functioning properly. Consequently, such systems can remain operationally active without resolving outstanding mission requirements. To address this limitation, we introduce Acquisition-State Telemetry (AST), a model free architecture that evaluates ongoing information acquisition from observable evidence relative to declared task requirements. Specifically, a domain interface maps raw observations into task resolution coordinates and normalized comparative representations, which are processed by a fixed causal monitor. translated_title: 无模型的任务相关信息运行时测量
translated_abstract: 自主系统日益需要对物理运动学、环境状态以及任务完成结果进行监控。尽管现有工作提供了规划信息搜寻动作和解读所获观测数据的方法，但目前的方法并未监控实时的信息收集过程是否正常运行。因此，这类系统可能在尚未解决未完成的任务需求的情况下仍持续保持运行状态。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了采集状态遥测，这是一种无模型架构，能够基于可观测证据相对于声明的任务需求来评估正在进行的信息采集过程。具体而言，一个领域接口将原始观测映射为任务解析坐标和归一化的比较表示，这些表示由一个固定的因果监控器进行处理。该监控器输出两个连续的实时信号，用以量化尚未解决需求的前瞻性进展……
tldr: 提出了一种无模型的采集状态遥测（AST）架构，通过固定的因果监控器输出实时信号，评估自主系统的信息采集过程是否真正朝着任务需求的解决方向正常推进。
en_tdlr: We introduce Acquisition-State Telemetry (AST), a model-free architecture that uses a fixed causal monitor emitting real-time signals to assess whether ongoing information gathering in autonomous systems is properly progressing toward declared task requirements.
